institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

professional-experience-faster.title: Mentioning specific years of professional experience predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
professional-experience-faster.body: Quantifying professional experience or tenure in a field accelerates the funding process for both men and women.

men-single-status-slower.title: Stating single marital status predicts slower funding for male borrowers.
men-single-status-slower.body: Male borrowers who explicitly identify as single tend to fund more slowly than those who do not.

environmental-protection-slower.title: Mentioning environmental protection predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
environmental-protection-slower.body: Pitches that focus on environmental or ecological concerns tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-savings-dreams-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention dreams of saving money predict slower funding.
female-savings-dreams-slower.body: Pitches from women that focus on the dream of saving money tend to fund more slowly than those that do not.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
female-age-slower.body: Pitches from women that include the borrower's age tend to fund more slowly than those that omit it.

female-entrepreneur-faster.title: Female borrowers who identify as entrepreneurs fund faster.
female-entrepreneur-faster.body: Pitches from women that use the term 'entrepreneur' to describe themselves tend to accelerate funding.

hardship-gender-interaction.body: Details regarding personal hardships may accelerate funding for women but slow it for men.

pitch-length-gender-interaction.body: Pitch length may accelerate funding for women while decelerating it for men.

female-ag-success-slower.body: Mentioning previous business success in agricultural pitches may predict slower funding for women.

female-marital-status-slower.body: Mentioning marital status or widowhood may predict slower funding for female borrowers.

female-social-goals-faster.body: Mentioning specific social goals like food security or children's education may accelerate funding for women.

female-local-currency-slower.body: Including the exact loan amount in local currency may predict slower funding for women.

female-number-of-children-slower.body: Mentioning the specific number of children may predict slower funding for female borrowers.

female-self-effort-slower.body: Female borrowers who emphasize sustaining their business through their own efforts may fund more slowly.

women-assets-experience.title: Female borrowers who list specific assets or professional backgrounds may fund faster.
women-assets-experience.retrospective: Promoted and generalized to a gender-neutral claim after corroboration in male pairs.

men-family-wellbeing.title: Male borrowers who focus on children or family well-being may fund faster.
men-family-wellbeing.retrospective: Promoted to gender-general claim after corroboration in female pairs.

female-specific-ages-faster.title: Female borrowers who include specific ages for themselves or their children may fund faster.
female-specific-ages-faster.retrospective: Promoted to gender-general claim after corroboration in male pairs.

male-hardship-details-slower.title: Male borrowers who provide extensive details on location or personal hardships may fund slower.
male-hardship-details-slower.retrospective: Merged into interaction puzzle after conflicting evidence in female pairs.

men-marital-status.title: Male borrowers who explicitly state their marital status may see faster funding.
men-marital-status.retrospective: Promoted and refined to a specific claim about single status slowing funding.

male-brevity-faster.title: Shorter pitch texts may predict faster funding for male borrowers.
male-brevity-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by female observation where lengthier pitches funded faster, suggesting an interaction.

female-concrete-goals-faster.title: Pitches from women that mention specific goals like college or certified seeds accelerate funding.
female-concrete-goals-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that mentioning college as a goal slows funding for women.

female-hardworking-slower.title: Pitches from women that emphasize personal traits like being hardworking or putting in hard work predict slower funding.
female-hardworking-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted age claim due to memory cap.

family-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete details about children or household stability accelerate funding for both men and women.
family-details-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observations that mentioning the number of children predicts slower funding for women.
